personal.preferred_title: Senior Data Engineer | Python, SQL, Spark, Cloud Pipelines & Data Quality

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark, cloud data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality validation, production support, observability, root cause analysis, and regulated enterprise data environments. Strong background building and operating production-grade pipelines, validation frameworks, monitoring workflows, curated reporting layers, and reliable data products for technical and business stakeholders. Best aligned to roles requiring batch/streaming-style data engineering, cloud-native pipeline delivery, data accuracy, completeness, freshness, reliability, and secure data handling; healthcare interoperability formats such as HL7, FHIR, CCDA, ADT, Epic, Cerner, HEDIS, and HCC are positioned as domain-adjacent learning areas rather than overstated production ownership.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built Python/Pandas/PySpark ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated datasets for reporting, analytics, forecasting, and stakeholder decision-making.

Designed AWS-based data platform components using S3 landing zones, AWS Glue, Athena, Redshift, Oracle, SQL, and PySpark to support scalable transformation, querying, and production reporting workflows.

Built data quality, reconciliation, and validation practices across BMC TrueSight, CA Wily, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed reporting layers to improve accuracy, completeness, and trust in pipeline outputs.
Instrumented production data workflows with monitoring, alerting concepts, troubleshooting checkpoints, operational runbooks, and review processes to improve reliability and issue detection.
Performed root cause analysis for data and reporting issues, coordinating with infrastructure, application, monitoring, and analytics teams to restore trust in business-facing outputs.
Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and historical retention models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware access.
Developed schema-aware reporting layers, dashboards, and curated datasets that supported executive capacity insights, forecasting workflows, and operational analytics.
Documented pipeline logic, metric definitions, validation assumptions, operational support steps, and data handling practices for regulated enterprise environments.

experience.title: Performance Engineer

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)

Built C++/OCCI/OCI validation and regression testing utilities to verify correctness across millions of migrated transaction records.
Automated schema conversion, data validation, and phased cutover support for a mission-critical enterprise migration.

experience.title: Developer / Support Engineer (Billing, Interfaces, CSM/PRMS)
